title: Website Feature Flags
description: Build-time feature flags for the comfy.org website. Imported as a JSON module and bundled at build. Mirrors a subset of the main Vue app's remoteConfig flags so the two systems can be unified later.

cloudFreeTier.description: When true, render the Cloud free tier card on /cloud/pricing, the 'TRY COMFY CLOUD FOR FREE' hero CTA on /cloud, the 'Start free. Upgrade when you're ready.' tagline on the /cloud pricing teaser, and the 'Build and edit workflows for free' phrasing in the pricing description. When false, all of those free-tier surfaces are hidden and replaced with neutral copy. Mirrors remoteConfig.new_free_tier_subscriptions in the main Vue app.
